explanation: The time remaining before the end of the world comes, often described as a period in which God patiently waits for people to turn away from sin.
The period between creation and the day of judgment; for humans it seems slow, but for God a thousand years are like one day.
The great flood in Noah's time that destroyed the old world with water, used as an image of how the earth will now be cleansed by fire.
The element that will cleanse and renew heaven and earth at the day of judgment; it symbolizes God's holy righteousness and final judgment on sin.
Describes the future state where God has created a new heaven and a new earth, free from sin and death, where righteousness dwells.
God's attribute of delaying His judgment to give people time for repentance; there is no slowness in God's plans, but mercy.
The act by which a person turns away from sin and back to God, something 2 Peter urges readers to do before the great day comes.
